query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ms_spectra (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  compound_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  cas_number VARCHAR(50),
  molecular_formula VARCHAR(100),
  molecular_weight DECIMAL(10,4),
  ionization_mode ENUM('EI', 'CI', 'ESI', 'APCI') DEFAULT 'EI',
  base_peak_mz DECIMAL(10,4),
  base_peak_intensity INT DEFAULT 100,
  spectrum_data JSON,
  fragmentation_pattern TEXT,
  source VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'NIST',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
